My Study Plan (EXAMPLE)

Name: Jamaal Ahmad        My mock test score: 148 (B1 Grade C)
My exam date: 28/06/2020  My target exam score: 155 (B1 Grade B)
                          My areas to work on:
                          Writing and Speaking – range of grammar and vocabulary.
                          Listening – stay calm when I listen, so I can listen more carefully.

Week 1         Tasks

Week 3 Week 2  Monday: Make vocabulary cards with an example sentence for the new vocabulary I learned in the
               mock test – test myself each day (vocabulary).
Week 4         Saturday: Meet with study buddy for speaking practice – 1 hour.
               Do one activity on the Exam Lift app every day (all skills.)

               Monday: Do 20 minutes of grammar practice activities (grammar).
               Saturday morning: Do a writing task on the Write and Improve website, remember to proofread
               before submitting. Use the feedback, identify the common errors I need to work on.
               Do one activity on the Exam Lift app every day (all skills).

               Monday and Wednesday: Complete self-study plan for B1 listening (listening,
               vocabulary, grammar).
               Do one activity on the Exam Lift app every day (all skills).

               Final week before exam!!!
               Monday: Do 20 minutes of grammar practice activities (grammar).
               Wednesday: Do a writing task on Write and Improve (writing), take care with common errors,
               don’t forget to proofread before submitting.
               Friday: Do a listening activity on cambridgeenglish.org – get an early night!

Exam checklist:

Before the exam
        I know the time, date and location of my exam.
        I know how long it takes to travel to the exam centre.
        I have registered for the online results service.

On exam day
        Photographic identification (I.D)
        Pens, pencils and erasers
        A bottle of water in a clear plastic bottle
